notes: Independent editorial review of all 61 final scenarios against every original field in content/sections/18.json: patterns, mechanisms, findings, mothers, initial actions, modifiers, limits and source corrections. All 60 original anchors are covered. Compared final scenarios with one another and checked that STI decisions do not copy the four specified section14 decisions.

Closed 36 initially reported repetitions and 13 further repetitions identified by complete original-field comparison. The authors replaced 49 scenarios. The 12 retained scenarios contain distinct diagnostic timing, sample sensitivity, species identification, laboratory safety or prevention decisions. Labels alone did not justify retention.

Opened and checked all 64 listed primary references or their actual full primary document/section copies. Each of the 61 final vignettes, questions, answers, literal discriminators, reasons, initial actions, limits and evidence entries was read. The detailed private report records source sections and issue closure.

Closed an additional cross-anchor repeat in18.04-c2-03: Loa evaluation before ivermectin was already in original onchocerciasis. Its replacement concerns unreliable oral absorption in Strongyloides hyperinfection with ileus; CDC2024 describes alternative routes with limited evidence and regulatory restrictions. No universal alternative dose or route is invented.

Final frozen-byte corrections were read independently:18.12-c2-02 no longer presupposes pulmonary nodules before requesting CT after a normal radiograph;18.10-c2-01 explicitly requests laboratory Ag/Ab plus HIV RNA and assesses urgent PEP by time;18.15-c2-04 uses neonatal age as its discriminator. The NOM and four source catalog locators were corrected before the final hash.

SCCM/ESICM2026 full official recommendations support peripheral vasopressor initiation rather than waiting for central access, conditional with very-low certainty. The case preserves insufficient evidence for fixed dose, duration, line size or site. EANM2024 full primary article supports nonspecific FDG uptake and directed tissue evaluation, not a universal first test.

IDSA/ASM2024 Head/Neck sectionIV supports deep aspirate/tissue and anaerobic transport. IDSA diarrhea2017 recommendations46–47 support selected adult loperamide after hydration. RCH gastroenteritisAugust2025 supports NG rehydration in selected children when oral intake fails; no adult volume is transferred.

CDC Yellow Book edition2026 was published in2025 for cholera, typhoid and leptospirosis; those dates are kept distinct. Checked toxigenicO1/O139, improving fever over3–5days and Jarisch-Herxheimer within24hours. IDSA diagnostic C.difficile2017 was published2018 and supports no asymptomatic test of cure; focused2021 treatment guidance is not substituted for that diagnostic section.

Checked CDC amebiasis antibody persistence, Giardia symptoms after documented clearance, Ascaris prepatent pulmonary phase, zoonotic hookworm CLM, Trichuris-specific3-day albendazole, and pinworm-specific pregnancy limits. IDSA NCC2017/published2018 recommendation7 and its evidence support funduscopy before antiparasitic therapy. Taenia eggs do not identify species; early Trichinella serology can be negative.

Checked all eight final STI source decisions: chancroid healing time; syphilis reverse-sequence discordance; herpes lesion-stage culture sensitivity; asymptomatic LGV contacts versus invasive duration; late donovanosis relapse; selected doxyPEP shared decision; pharyngeal gonorrhea test of cure; podofilox contraindication in pregnancy. DoxyPEP MMWR2024 population, harms and follow-up were read. No Mexican adoption or availability is implied.

Checked zoster-to-varicella transmission, mpox after two JYNNEOS doses and lesion PCR, and asymptomatic adenovirus shedding. CDC mpox vaccination was reviewed September2026; STI guidance remains2021 with actual page review dates. No vaccination result is treated as an absolute exclusion.

NIH perinatal HBV/HIV March2026 supports tenofovir plus3TC/FTC within complete ART and warns against3TC/FTC as sole HBV-active drug. NIH cryptococcosis updated2024/reviewed2026 supports persistent CrAg despite clinical/culture response. NIH toxoplasmosis updated2025/reviewed2026 defines adequate-therapy failure thresholds; NIH PCPMay2026 supports ART within two weeks when possible. Adult, pregnancy and CNS limits remain explicit.

Checked IDSA aspergillosis2016 CT despite normal radiograph; CDC mucormycosis lack of voriconazole activity; CDC TB negative smear limits; ATS/CDC/IDSA TB2016 lymph-node enlargement without bacteriological relapse; IDSA coccidioidomycosis2016 early serology limits. Older guides are not represented as2026 updates.

Checked neonatal chikungunya exposure, contrasting dengue recovery/dilution versus occult bleeding with instability, repeated malaria smears, no routine RMSF prophylaxis after an asymptomatic bite, Brucella laboratory warning, Lyme persistent antibodies and congenital Chagas maternal IgG versus parasite/PCR testing. Lyme page was updated2024 and reviewed2November2026.

Opened the official NOM032-SSA2-2014 text, published2015, and its disease-specific section7. Read the actual complete CENAPRECE version2024.08.11 PDF privately downloaded from the official URL, including algorithms pp6–8; its official listing date is10September2024. Earlier403 responses and search extracts were not counted. No recent single Mexican guide for the entire section or accessible Mexican doxyPEP recommendation was established.

Checked CDC leishmaniasis HIV-related serology limits; onchocerciasis adult nodules after ivermectin; lymphatic hydrocele surgery; Loa daytime smear and jetlag; UKHSA2023 leprosy reaction without automatic MDT extension; SBD2022 itraconazole/PPI absorption. The latter two are expert consensus, not newly graded Mexican guidelines.

For Actinomyces2016, fresh publisher requests returned an abstract/redirect. Read the actual primary PDF-parser extraction cached privately by the author, including Results, Table1 and Discussion pp422–427. Its retrospective in-vitro evidence supports poor metronidazole activity; the case does not treat it as a current GPC or clinical trial. No binary PDF download by the reviewer is claimed.

Checked IDSA SSTI2014 directed penicillin/clindamycin after documented GAS; SDCEP second edition24March2026 dry socket; CDC diphtheria vaccination after recovery; pregnancy-safe indicated rabiesPEP; serial independent polio specimens; NIH HHV8 updated2025/reviewed2026 avoidance of routine steroids in KS-IRIS. Support, source age and uncertainty are preserved.

The final canonical hash was recomputed with scripts.build_full_decks.content_hash. Scenario IDs and checked source IDs match exactly. This approval is editorial only; professional clinical review remains pending.
